## X-Sense Home Security v1.4.19.2

### 📷 Camera Events
- Expands the initial camera history recovery window so recent motion and AI-detection events can be found after setup, reload, or restart.
- Continues later history checks from the last successful poll with overlap to avoid missing events between requests.
- Tries the camera identities supplied by X-Sense individually when a multi-Home camera returns an empty recording history.

### 🚨 Detector States
- Corrects coded alarm, silence, and activation states so all APK-supported status values are represented correctly.
- Consolidates alternate X-Sense payload fields into the existing Alarm Status, Device Silenced, and Activated entities instead of exposing duplicates.

### 💧 Water Leak Sensors
- Keeps the SWS51 water-alarm, water-silence, temperature-alarm, and temperature-silence entities available while their first complete update is pending.
- Removes stale generic alarm and silence entities from SWS51 devices, which use separate water and temperature states.
